# ADR-3065: A06: SBOM required key for release artifact 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Without SBOMs, blast radius of CVEs is unknown.

## Decision

Release pipelines SHALL emit an SBOM required key for release artifact 5 (A06-5).

## Consequences

SBOMs attach to provenance attestations.
